description: Submit a solved WorkSats task ticket (`tsk_...`) to mint a signed bearer credit token (`crd_...`). For house tasks, provide `checksum` and `scriptPubKeys`; for bounty tasks, provide `answer` or mode-specific fields (`addresses`, `address`, `scriptPubKey`, `feeSats`, `inputCount`, `outputCount`, `data`).

answer.description: Canonical answer string (for `sha256` buyer-funded bounty tasks).

data.description: Structured JSON solution object (for `json_schema` bounty tasks).

feeSats.description: Decoded PSBT fee in sats (for `psbt_feerate` bounty tasks).

inputCount.description: Decoded PSBT input count (for `psbt_feerate` bounty tasks).

outputCount.description: Decoded PSBT output count (for `psbt_feerate` bounty tasks).

scriptPubKeys.description: Derived scriptPubKey hex strings (for house or `descriptor_derive` tasks).

name: worksats_solve_task
